from support import *
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
root=Path('test-data/registry-'+str(time.time_ns()));root.mkdir(parents=True)
f=root/'source.bin';f.write_bytes(bytes(range(256))*16);expected=identity(f)
with Server(root/'data') as s:
 assert s.request('GET','/api/repos')[2]=={'items':[],'page':1,'pageSize':20,'total':0}
 for name in ['zeta','alpha','middle']:s.json('POST','/api/repos',{'name':name,'description':'test'},201)
 s.json('POST','/api/repos',{'name':'alpha'},409);s.json('POST','/api/repos',{'name':'../bad'},400)
 assert s.request('GET','/api/repos/absent')[0]==404
 assert s.request('GET','/api/repos/alpha')[2]['description']=='test'
 assert [r['name'] for r in s.request('GET','/api/repos?pageSize=2')[2]['items']]==['alpha','middle']
 for q in ['page=0','page=-1','page=1.1','pageSize=0','pageSize=-1','pageSize=no','pageSize=101']:
  assert s.request('GET','/api/repos?'+q)[0]==400,q
  assert s.request('GET','/api/repos/alpha/artifacts?'+q)[0]==400,q
 for name,version in [('bbb','v2'),('aaa','v3'),('aaa','v1')]:s.put(artifact('alpha',name,version),f)
 assert [(v['name'],v['version']) for v in s.request('GET','/api/repos/alpha/artifacts')[2]['items']]==[('aaa','v1'),('aaa','v3'),('bbb','v2')]
 assert s.request('GET','/api/repos/alpha/artifacts?prefix=aaa')[2]['total']==2
 assert len(s.request('GET','/api/repos/alpha/artifacts?page=2&pageSize=2')[2]['items'])==1
 path=artifact('alpha','race','v1')
 def upload(_):
  c=http.client.HTTPConnection(s.host,int(s.port),timeout=10)
  try:
   c.request('PUT',path,b'complete race');r=c.getresponse();r.read();return r.status
  finally:c.close()
 with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:out=sorted(pool.map(upload,[1,2],timeout=15))
 assert out==[201,409],out
 assert s.request('GET',path)[2]['size']==13
 with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
  list(pool.map(lambda n:s.put(artifact('alpha',n,'v1'),f),['independentA','independentB'],timeout=15))
 s.put(artifact('alpha','aaa','v1'),f,409)
 s.download(artifact('alpha','aaa','v3'),expected)
 assert s.request('DELETE',artifact('alpha','aaa','v1'))[0]==204
 assert s.request('DELETE',artifact('alpha','aaa','v1'))[0]==404
 s.download(artifact('alpha','aaa','v3'),expected)
 print(json.dumps({'registry':'passed','concurrent_statuses':out,'survivor':expected,'data':str(root)}))
